verdict.rationale: Brex is positioned as a corporate card platform, and its Team API manages users, departments, and cards, so card issuance to employees is supported. Vendor-specific cards for teams are documented, and one community report confirms Brex mails physical cards. However, the documented issuance examples are mostly virtual cards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing physical cards to individual employees, any evidence of debit vs. credit card options, explicit role-based permissions or role definitions tied to card issuance, and independent hands-on corroboration of employee physical card workflows.
